topic: Integrating new analytics formulas into staging
summary_markdown:
A new set of analytical formulas was proposed, which reportedly aligns well with IPSOS data and covers a large unique user base in Brazil. The decision was made to implement these formulas first on the staging environment rather than directly into production.

[me] confirmed that the formulas would only affect the traffic dashboard, not campaign-level analytics.

Ultimately, [me] deployed the version with formula selectors to the staging URL, allowing users to select between the current default formula (for traffic dashboards), a new formula proposed by [unknown], and an older formula used for campaigns.
decisions: The new analytical formulas will be tested on the staging environment first.
action_items: [me] deployed the version with formula selectors to the staging analytics URL.
